source: Money Rooms v3 spec, Lenses; sentences are information, never instructions

lenses.name: Saving at a loss
lenses.trigger: cash above the Rule of 5 target while a debt charges more than cash earns
lenses.template: Keeping {excess} in cash while {debt} charges {apr} costs about {cost} a year.

lenses.name: Match left on the table
lenses.trigger: match captured below 100%
lenses.template: The employer match not taken is about {cost} a year.

lenses.name: Promo cliff
lenses.trigger: a promo APR ends within 12 months
lenses.template: {card} goes from {promo} to {apr} in {months}; at today's balance that is about {cost} a year.

lenses.name: Cash drag
lenses.trigger: cash above the Rule of 5 target
lenses.template: Cash above the Rule of 5 target, about {excess}, earns about {cost} a year less than invested money would.

lenses.name: Fee drag
lenses.trigger: weighted expense ratio above 0.25%
lenses.template: Fund fees at {er} cost about {cost} a year, about {lifetime} by retirement.

lenses.name: Shelter heavy
lenses.trigger: accommodation above 35% of take-home
lenses.template: Housing takes {share} of take-home, about {cost} a year above the 35% line.

lenses.name: Hidden leak
lenses.trigger: leak above 5% of take-home
lenses.template: About {cost} a year is left by the math but does not land in savings.

lenses.name: Wrong debt first
lenses.trigger: the stress-weighted order costs more than avalanche
lenses.template: Paying the most stressful debt first costs about {cost} more in interest than the highest rate first; sometimes relief is worth it.

lenses.name: Utilization drag
lenses.trigger: any card above 30% or total above 10%
lenses.template: {card} is at {utilization} of its limit; scores tend to lift under 30% and most under 10%.

lenses.name: Tax room unused
lenses.trigger: room under a pre-tax limit while surplus leaks
lenses.template: Putting the {leak} a year that leaks into the 401k would save about {cost} in federal tax.

lenses.name: Thin runway
lenses.trigger: FAT runway under 3 months
lenses.template: Cash covers {months} of the lean month; the gap to three months is about {cost}.

lenses.name: Locked up
lenses.trigger: liquid share under 30% with a retirement age before 59.5
lenses.template: Only {share} of assets are reachable before 59.5, with retirement planned at {age}.

lenses.name: Real hourly wage
lenses.trigger: real hourly wage under 70% of the stated wage
lenses.template: After taxes, commuting and the costs of working, an hour pays {real}, not {stated}.

lenses.name: Cost in hours
lenses.trigger: annual interest above the materiality line
lenses.template: This year's interest, about {cost}, is {hours} of work at the real hourly wage.

lenses.name: One more point
lenses.trigger: a FI date exists
lenses.template: One more point of take-home saved, about {amount} a month, moves the FI date about {months} earlier.

lenses.name: Coast check
lenses.trigger: net worth at or above the Coast FI number
lenses.template: Today's {netWorth} could grow to the FI number by {age} with no more saving.

lenses.name: Mistake tax
lenses.trigger: spending lines marked mistake above the materiality line
lenses.template: Fees, penalties and regretted purchases add up to about {cost} a year.

lenses.name: Card not paying its fee
lenses.trigger: a card's fee exceeds credits used plus rewards above a no-fee card
lenses.template: {card} costs about {cost} a year more than a no-fee card would on the same spending; {credits} of its credits go unused.

lenses.name: Wrong card for the category
lenses.trigger: rewards left on the table above the materiality line
lenses.template: The same spending on the best card already in the wallet for each category would earn about {cost} more a year.

lenses.name: The double lever
lenses.trigger: a FI number exists
lenses.template: Every $100 a month cut lowers the FI number by {perHundred} and adds {perHundredYear} a year to savings; the same $100 earned only does the second.

lenses.name: The big three
lenses.trigger: housing, transportation and food together above 50% of take-home
lenses.template: Housing, transportation and food take {share} of take-home ({dollars} a month); the rest of the budget is working around them.

lenses.name: Lean FI is close
lenses.trigger: Lean FI reached or within 3 years
lenses.template: The floor ({number}) is {when}: a lean month is already paid for by the portfolio, or nearly.

lenses.name: The Barista option
lenses.trigger: part-time income needed to be Barista FI today is under half of take-home
lenses.template: {needed} a month of part-time income would make today Barista FI: the portfolio covers the rest at {wr}.

lenses.name: Coast reached
lenses.trigger: the FI progress basis is at or above the Coast FI number
lenses.template: {basis} already coasts to the FI number by {age} at {ret}; new contributions buy an earlier date, not the retirement itself.

lenses.name: Crossover in sight
lenses.trigger: the crossover date is within 5 years
lenses.template: Investment income at {wr} covers spending from {date}: about {when} away.

lenses.name: The flip
lenses.trigger: the portfolio already grows more from returns than from contributions, or will within 3 years
lenses.template: {when} the portfolio grows more from returns ({growth} a year) than from what goes in ({contrib}).

lenses.name: The first $100,000
lenses.trigger: invested assets under $100,000 with a projected date
lenses.template: The first $100,000 lands about {date}; after that the market does more of the lifting.

lenses.name: The after-tax gap
lenses.trigger: the true FI number exceeds the FI number by 5% or more
lenses.template: Taxes on withdrawals from pre-tax accounts add {gap} to the FI number: {trueFi} instead of {fi}.

lenses.name: The health care bridge
lenses.trigger: the FI date is before 65
lenses.template: Health insurance from the FI date to 65 is about {cost}: {years} at {premium} a month.

lenses.name: The Social Security floor
lenses.trigger: Social Security lowers the FI number by 10% or more
lenses.template: Counting Social Security from {age} lowers the FI number to {number} ({saving} less), with the bridge years funded from the portfolio.

lenses.name: 3.5% instead of 4%
lenses.trigger: a FI date exists
lenses.template: A 3.5% withdrawal rate instead of 4% raises the FI number to {number} and moves the FI date about {months}.

lenses.name: Guardrails room
lenses.trigger: a FI date exists
lenses.template: In retirement, spending between {low} and {high} a month keeps the withdrawal rate within {band} of its start.

lenses.name: House hack
lenses.trigger: accommodation above 40% of take-home
lenses.template: Housing takes {share} of take-home; a roommate, a rental unit or a cheaper place is the single biggest lever here.

lenses.name: Geographic arbitrage
lenses.trigger: coach-triggered: the coach has flagged a move
lenses.template: A 20% lower cost of living would lower the FI number by {number} and move the FI date about {months}.

lenses.name: Gut against the lines
lenses.trigger: gut spending differs from the lines by 10% or more
lenses.template: The gut guess ({gut}) is {direction} the lines ({lines}) by {diff} a month: about {months} of FI date.

lenses.name: Room to spend more
lenses.trigger: projected net worth at 95 is above three times the FI number, or dream spending is above actual and the FI date still lands
lenses.template: The projection ends at {at95}, well above the FI number: there is room to spend on what matters now.

lenses.name: A purchase in FI days
lenses.trigger: a FI date exists
lenses.template: Here, $1,000 spent once costs about {days} of FI date, and $100 a month costs {number} of FI number.

lenses.name: The side hustle, by the hour
lenses.trigger: side income with hours typed earns under the main job per hour
lenses.template: Side income earns {side} an hour against {main} at the main job; the hours may be worth more elsewhere.

lenses.name: Underspending
lenses.trigger: savings rate above 50% with projected net worth at 95 above three times the FI number
lenses.template: Saving {rate} of take-home with a projection that ends at {at95}: some of this money could buy experiences now.

lenses.name: If it all falls on you
lenses.trigger: shared lines above 25% of take-home, or the lease in the client's name only
lenses.template: If {nickname} moved out, your share of {lines} would go from {share} to {full} a month. Covering {months} months while you find someone takes about {bridge}.
